value.rationale: The source literature explicitly asserts complete statistical equivalence based on the mean. The exact counterexample and iff classification repair a scientifically consequential identifiability distinction. More strongly, global sharp Laplace- and variance envelopes with unique optimizers quantify the entire range of possible first-passage fluctuations at a prescribed mean and constrained reset geometry, without relying on numerical fitting. The result is motivated by physical resetting protocol design and second-order measurements, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
